mappings.rationale: Held-out validation shows 9000/9000 emissions with no errors, but this confirms only that values are non-empty, not that they are registered legal names. Field confidence 0.6 is below the 0.8 minimum, so this mapping is retained only for review and will not meet threshold. Names may be individuals (Licence Type DESC = Individual) and are not verified as registered legal names.

Explicitly labelled ABN column, sparse. Held-out: 4969 non-empty, 4912 pass checksum; 57 fail the abn checksum and are rejected by the engine. Nulls emit nothing. Mapping correctness is high; coverage is sparse.
Explicitly labelled ACN column, sparse. Held-out: 2108 non-empty, 2096 pass ACN checksum; 12 rejected. Not derived from ABN.
Single labelled business address string for the licensee, 9000/9000 emitted. Mapped as full address only; locality, state and postcode are not reliably separable without parsing, so left unmapped.

warnings: observed_at_field is null: the only time is resource_last_modified_proxy, a publication proxy, not a verified record statement time.
